author: Kimeko McCoy
title: Walmart Connect pitches brands directly as it pushes lift studies ahead of holiday ad deals
description: Walmart Connect is using lift studies to prove ad performance directly to brands ahead of the holidays, signaling a tighter race with Amazon.
content: When it comes to retail media networks, theres Amazon, Walmart and everyone else. Walmart Connect is taking a direct approach to win over even more advertisers and theyre bypassing agencies to do it.… [+3878 chars]
